item.title: CJNG Violence After the Killing of ‘El Mencho’: Power Play or Last Gasp?
item.description: CJNG Violence After the Killing of ‘El Mencho’: Power Play or Last Gasp? The government’s killing of “El Mencho” on February 22 provoked a spasm of violence by his cartel that has been, in some ways, unprecedented. But previous displays of force by aggrieved criminal groups have proven to be largely temporary and, in most instances, a last gasp before sputtering and atomizing.
